title: EGFR fresh Gate3 recovery with scoped-result and Site-citation fail-safe handling
scope: One new EGFR fresh attempt from Gate1 through a validated Gate3 decision card; Gate3 is not approved.
precedence: This addendum governs only EGFR r5. Base-cohort and earlier failed-attempt records remain immutable.

supersedes_recovery_addendum.disposition: r4 audit authority; retained unchanged after r4 exposed a distinct SiteResearchHandoff citation failure

change_boundary.scoped_result: Retain the v1 receipt fix: exact /result-*.json references are shown, while a literal full_result label receives only bounded owned-reference repair feedback.
change_boundary.site_citation: After all bounded Site handoff submissions are spent, a Runtime-proven non-verbatim decision-question citation is removed and only that question is demoted to UNRESOLVED. The normalized handoff must pass the complete dossier validator before it can continue.
change_boundary.authority: No citation text is rewritten or inferred. Candidate geometry, source artifacts, Target/Site mappings and unaffected questions remain unchanged. Foreign source IDs, invalid candidate citations, hard-fact contradictions and any handoff that still fails full validation remain fatal.
change_boundary.scientific_effect: The fallback loses unsupported evidence strength rather than granting it. Independent Judge review and the Scientist Gate still receive the demotion and original durable evidence.

execution.goal: Design a VHH nanobody against the human EGFR ectodomain that is intended to inhibit ligand-driven receptor activation.

freshness_contract.project_state: Use a never-before-existing r5 project, thread, run ID and runtime-state path. Do not resume or copy r2-r4 state.
freshness_contract.tracked_tree: Clean at attempt start except the pre-existing protected untracked audit, which remains byte-untouched.
freshness_contract.failed_attempts: Retain r2-r4 projects and logs unchanged for audit.

required: current Design proposal and Gate3 decision card exist
compiled design artifacts pass size and SHA verification
no Gate3 response or design approval exists
no Pilot, handoff, generation or StrategyBundle event/path exists
